title: Personal Coaching App Alternative: 4 Options Compared (2026)
description: Four ways to get your own coaching app in India: agency-built, app builders, an all-in-one academy platform, or WhatsApp and Telegram. Costs, ownership and fit.
og_description: Agency-built app, app builder, all-in-one academy platform, or WhatsApp and Telegram: the four real ways to give your students an app, with published prices checked on official sites on 24 Oct 2026 and who each one suits.
keywords: should i build my own coaching app
h1: Personal Coaching App Alternative (2026): 4 Ways to Give Students Your Own App, Compared
dek: Getting a coaching app built by an agency is one way to have your own app. There are three others. Here is what each costs where prices are published, what you own, and which one fits your teaching.
cover_alt: Personal coaching app alternative: agency-built app, app builders, an all-in-one academy platform and WhatsApp or Telegram compared, prices checked 24 Oct 2026
audience: Independent educators and coaching institute owners in India deciding how to get their own coaching app
intro: There are four ways to give your students an app of your own: have an agency build a custom app, use an app-builder platform, use an all-in-one academy platform that includes your app and website, or run on WhatsApp and Telegram without an app. They differ most in what you pay before you earn, who can change the app after launch, and whether payments, live classes and tests come built in.

Owning your app was never the problem. Owning one you cannot change, update or afford to maintain is. The right choice depends on how many students you have, how much you want to do yourself, and whether you need a website on your own domain as well.

We are AllCoaching, so read this knowing who wrote it. We are one of the four options. Every other price below comes from the company's own website, with the link and the date we checked it (24 Oct 2026), and we say where another option fits better.
takeaways: Four options: agency-built custom app, app-builder platform, all-in-one academy platform, or WhatsApp and Telegram with no app.
Agency-built apps have no standard price; quotes depend on scope, and you also pay for updates, hosting and developer accounts.
Classplus lists ₹29,999 for 1 year with an Android app listed on its plan; iOS is not listed (checked 24 Oct 2026).
On several platforms a branded app is a higher plan or an add-on: Learnyst from Premium (₹13,499/month billed annually), Edmingle from Prime, Exly as an add-on from ₹60,000 a year.

AllCoaching includes your own Android app (iOS app on Pro or any yearly plan) and your own domain website on every plan, with 0% commission on every monthly plan (from ₹3,999 a month), or Starter at ₹6,999 a year plus a 10% fee on sales, GST extra, after a 7-day free trial with no card.
WhatsApp and Telegram cost nothing and students already use them, but there is no checkout, no course library and no brand of your own.
Whatever you choose, your own student list and original content files are what you truly own; keep copies outside any app.

Many educators move between these over time: WhatsApp for the first batch, then an app of their own once students are paying.

sections.h2: How we compared the four options
sections.html:
We compared the four ways an Indian educator can give students an app, on five things that decide the real cost and the real ownership.

  1. Cost before your first sale: build fee, plan price or add-on, from official pages only.
  2. Cost as you grow: any percentage on sales.
  3. Who can change it: you in a studio, or a developer or vendor.
  4. What comes built in: website, payments, live classes, tests, Android and iOS.
  5. What you own: your domain, the app listing, and your student data.
Disclosure: AllCoaching publishes this guide and is one of the options. Competitor figures link to their official pages and carry the date we checked them (24 Oct 2026). Prices change; check the source before you decide. If you spot an error, write to contact@allcoaching.in and we will correct it.

sections.h2: Why educators look for an alternative to a custom-built app
sections.html:
Most educators who search for an alternative already have an app, or a quote for one, and something about it is not working. The reasons usually fall into three groups.

1. Every change needs a developer

A custom app does what it was built to do on launch day. Adding a new batch type, changing a price page or fixing a bug after an Android update means going back to the developer, and paying again.

2. The app is only one piece

An app on its own does not take payments, host live classes, run tests or give you a website on your own domain unless each was built in. Educators end up running the app alongside WhatsApp, Zoom, Google Forms and UPI screenshots.

{{q:Is building a personal coaching app a mistake?|No. Having your own app is a strong asset for a coaching brand. The mistake is owning one you cannot change yourself, cannot afford to keep updated, or that runs without payments, tests and a website around it.}}

3. Nobody downloads it

An app does not bring students by itself. If downloads are the problem, a new app will not fix it; read why a coaching app gets no students first.

{{fig:before-after|Before and after: an educator's own app that needs a developer for changes, with fees, notes and doubts still on other tools, compared with one academy login with your own website, app, live classes and checkout|An app of your own works best when everything else lives in the same place.}}

Here is each option with what it is good at, what it costs where a price is published, what to check, and who it suits.

1. Agency-built custom app

Good at
A design and feature set made only for you, with your own code if the contract says so.
Published price
No standard price; agencies quote by scope. Add updates, hosting, payment gateway charges and developer accounts with Google and Apple.
Free trial
Not applicable.
Check
Who owns the code and the store listings, what a yearly maintenance contract costs, and whether a website, payments and live classes are included.
Best for
Large institutes with an in-house tech person and needs no platform covers. See what a coaching app costs to build in India.

2. App-builder platform (Classplus, AppX and others)

Good at
A branded app on the vendor's technology, set up quickly. Classplus says "Get your own brand's teaching app, create your own website & sell courses"; AppX says "Launch your own branded app and website for your courses and community. No code needed."
Published price
Classplus ₹29,999 for 1 year (Android app listed; iOS not listed).[1] AppX: not listed on its website; free demo first.[2] Learnyst: branded Android from Premium, ₹14,999/month (₹13,499/month billed annually), taxes extra.[3] Edmingle: branded Android from Prime, ₹14,999/month billed annually; branded iOS from Power.[4]
Free trial
Varies: Edmingle 7 days; Classplus and AppX do not mention one.
Check
Whose developer account the app is published under (Learnyst's page says apps go under Learnyst's account), whether iOS is included, the renewal price and any fee on sales.
Best for
Institutes that want a vendor to provide the app and are happy with the plan the app comes on.
Our platform · disclosure

3. All-in-one academy platform (AllCoaching)

Good at
Your own Android app (iOS app on Pro or any yearly plan) and a website on your own domain, built by you in one studio, like Shopify for coaching: sign up, choose a plan, upload your course, connect your domain and start selling. Unlimited live classes, tests, notes and UPI checkout come with it.
Published price
0% commission on monthly plans (Starter ₹3,999, Growth ₹5,999, Pro ₹7,999 a month; keep 100% of every sale), or yearly from ₹6,999 + 10% on sales (Starter); GST extra. Pricing
Free trial
7 days, no card needed.
Check
You build it yourself from templates, so a fully custom design is not the goal; on yearly Starter the 10% fee on sales adds up as you grow (the monthly plans take 0%), and above about ₹2.3 lakh a year Classplus's listed price is lower on paper.
Best for
Educators who want their own app and website under their brand, and want to change things themselves.

4. WhatsApp and Telegram, no app

Good at
Reaching students on apps they already have. Groups and channels for notices, YouTube for lessons, Google Forms for quizzes.
Published price
Free to use.
Free trial
Not needed.
Check
No checkout, so fees arrive as UPI screenshots; no course library, no access control when a student stops paying, and no brand of your own.
Best for
A first batch, or testing whether a course will sell, before paying for anything. See WhatsApp channels for coaching.

{{cta}}

You are starting your first batch

Start on WhatsApp and YouTube, or build your academy inside a 7-day free trial. A spoken English trainer or a Class 10 maths tutor can test demand for free before paying. Our guide on how to sell courses online in India covers the first sale.

You have paying students and want your own brand

An all-in-one academy gives you your own app and website together. For a NEET biology educator or a UPSC mentor building a name, the website on your own domain matters as much as the app. See LMS with a custom domain.

You run a large institute with steady sales

A flat-price app builder can cost less above about ₹2.3 lakh a year. Ask whose account the app is under and whether iOS is included.

You need something no platform does

An agency-built app makes sense only here, and only with a maintenance contract and code ownership in writing.

You already have an app and are deciding whether to move

Money already spent should not decide the next step. Compare what the next year costs on each option. The own app or marketplace guide covers the trade-off.

sections.h2: How to move from your current app without losing students
sections.html:
The safe way to move is to build first and move students batch by batch. Current students keep the old app until their batch ends; new admissions go to the new one.

{{fig:switch|Four steps to move from a personal coaching app: build your academy, run both side by side, move new admissions, close the old app after the last batch|Students keep access until their batch ends.}} {{steps}}

The full checklist, including messages to send students, is in how to switch coaching apps without losing students.

items: List where your students come from
Write down how your last 20 students found you: YouTube, Instagram, WhatsApp, referrals or the app store.
Choose which matter most: your own domain, your own Android app (iOS app on Pro or any yearly plan) listing, or your student data export.
Price each option at your sales level
Add plan price, any add-on and any fee on sales at your real yearly sales, before GST.
Ask each vendor whose account the app is under and what you can export if you leave.
Build and test with one batch
Start the 7-day free trial, connect your domain and run one paid batch on the new academy.
Move the rest batch by batch
Keep current students on the old app until their batch ends, and send all new admissions to your own academy.

faq: What is the best alternative to a personal coaching app?

It depends on your stage. An all-in-one academy platform such as AllCoaching gives you your own Android app (iOS app on Pro or any yearly plan) and website with 0% commission on every monthly plan from ₹3,999 a month, or yearly from ₹6,999 plus a 10% fee on sales; an app builder such as Classplus lists ₹29,999 a year; WhatsApp and Telegram are free for a first batch; an agency-built app suits only unusual needs.
Is building a personal coaching app a mistake?
No. Your own app is a strong asset for a coaching brand. The mistake is owning one you cannot change yourself, cannot keep updated, or that runs without payments, tests and a website around it.
How much does a personal coaching app cost in India?

Agency-built apps have no standard price and are quoted by scope. On published prices, Classplus lists ₹29,999 a year with an Android app, Exly's app add-on starts at ₹60,000 a year, and AllCoaching includes Android app (iOS app on Pro or any yearly plan) with 0% commission on every monthly plan from ₹3,999 a month, or yearly from ₹6,999 plus a 10% fee on sales, GST extra.
What is the difference between a white-label app and a marketplace?

A white-label app carries your name and shows only your courses. A marketplace lists many educators in one app. AllCoaching gives you your own white-label app and also lists your courses on its marketplace app for discovery.
Will a marketplace put me next to my competitors?
On the marketplace app, yes, your courses appear alongside other educators. Your own website and your own app on AllCoaching show only your academy.
Do I need an app at all to teach online in India?
Not to start. Many educators run a first batch on YouTube and WhatsApp. An app of your own helps once students are paying and you want one place for classes, notes, tests and payments.
Whose developer account is my app published under?
It depends on the vendor, so ask in writing. Learnyst's pricing page says its apps are published under Learnyst's developer account; with an agency-built app, insist on your own account.
Can I move from my current app without losing students?
Yes. Build the new academy, keep current students on the old app until their batch ends, send new admissions to your own website and app, then export records and close the old app.
